name: claude-shell
description: A Claude-only shell for Meta Ray-Ban Display: glasses web app + relay server.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup -w relay
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start -w relay
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run demo -w relay
scripts.dev: concurrently -n relay,glasses -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w relay" "npm run dev -w glasses"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n relay,glasses -c magenta,cyan "DEMO=1 npm run dev -w relay" "npm run dev -w glasses"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w glasses && npm run typecheck -w relay
